dimensions.assessment: Affects passengers traveling with infants on newly acquired Amtrak passenger trains and Amtrak itself.
dimensions.evidence: To require Amtrak to install baby changing tables in bathrooms on passenger rail cars.

dimensions.assessment: Minor physical and operational adjustments involving the installation of a baby changing table and signage in at least one restroom per covered car.
dimensions.evidence: All covered passenger rail cars shall have a baby changing table in at least one restroom

dimensions.assessment: The source does not state federal spending levels, procurement costs, or economic impacts.
Amends chapter 243 of title 49, United States Code, to add a specific equipment requirement for newly solicited Amtrak passenger rail cars.
dimensions.evidence: Chapter 243 of title 49, United States Code, is amended by inserting after section 24313 the following

dimensions.assessment: Permanent requirement applying to all future newly built and solicited Amtrak passenger rail cars.
dimensions.evidence: is newly built and was solicited for purchase after the date of the enactment of the Baby Changing on Board Act

missing_information: Cost estimates for installing baby changing tables in new rail cars.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires newly built passenger rail cars owned and operated by Amtrak and solicited for purchase after enactment to include baby changing tables in at least one restroom, including ADA-compliant restrooms.
